title: Source: Salamander Drumkit (CC BY-SA 3.0) — archive extract support + first drum kit
description: Add salamander-drumkit source to apricity-sources: single 387,611,727-byte tar.bz2 from archive.org/details/SalamanderDrumkit (CC BY-SA 3.0, Alexander Holm). Needs a File extract step (tar.bz2) in the SDK, sha256 of the archive, attribution in credit/rights. Then import as samples + a kit (one layer per drum for v1), used to test/refine drum-kit features. Note SFZ paths use backslashes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: SDK part done: 28 scenarios pass (12 new, run red first); local e2e vs real tarball: 545 files fetched/skipped/removed. Not done: real archive.org download via HttpFetcher, kit import (samples+kit). HTTP global timeout raised to 1h.
